contexts.text: It is from the Lord that he is called a man, even if he is the worst.
The worst of all come from the so-called Christian world. AC 1886. Preface [end].
They who have more knowledge, are sometimes the worst of all.
The worst of all... can learn the truths of faith, and confirm them. AC 3923:9. AC 6222:5. AR 337:end.
The Israelites the worst of nations. AC 3686:end. AC 9320:4. AC 10396, Explained.
The Lord is present... and rules the smallest particulars, even with the worst.
The Hell behind, where the worst are... HH 578. Described.
The Hells in the western quarter are the worst of all. Described.
With the worst, the love of blaspheming... (has its delights).
This kind of profanation is the worst of all. Explained. DP 231:7.
The men of the Most Ancient Church (from being the wisest of men became) the worst.
In the midst (of an evil Society) are the worst... This (is in order) that the worst may be coerced and restrained. SE 5034.
That the worst Genii, or furies, have been shut up in Hell...
These are among the worst infernals. SE 1283:end. SE 2346. SE 2719.
They said that I was the worst...
That the worst in life, who have thought justly... receive the truths of faith more easily than those who have lived morally outwardly, but have thought evil things. Explained.
On the worst Hell, which was from the Most Ancient Church. Explained.
On the worst magicians of all, from Africa. Explained. SE 4989.
The Swedish nation is the worst in Europe, except the Italian and the Russian.
Among the worst in the other life are priests who have been raised to dignities... SE 5074:2.
